pricingNote: Prices were checked Oct 17, 2026 (17 October 2026) on https://factory.com/pricing. Pro is $20 a month. Plus is $100 a month, ~5x the usage of Pro, and includes Droid Computers, which are Factory-managed cloud computers. Max is $200 a month, ~10x the usage of Pro, with early access to new features. Teams is $60 a month per team plus $40 a month per seat, up to 10 seats, with centralized billing. Business is tailored, with no price shown, and lists SSO, SAML and SCIM, Zero Data Retention, and audit logs. Enterprise has no price shown. Contact them for on-prem options, data residency, and dedicated compute. No free plan is listed on the pricing page, so none is shown. Usage limits are rolling rate limits described only as multiples of Pro. No token count is printed, so none is shown. factory.ai redirects to factory.com.
